items.rationale: The novelty statement is restricted to the frozen 12-source abstract/notes-level set, and the packet's screening result explicitly reports that no record contained the full stated comparison configuration. The claim does not extend absence beyond that bounded set.
decisive_evidence: review_scope: 'Bounded abstract/notes-based synthesis of 12 verified 2024-2026 records on autonomous scientific research agents and adjacent evidence-grounding systems.'

screening_result: 'Among the 12 included records, end-to-end agent papers and claim/citation-verification papers occurred as separate groups; no screening record described all of same backbone, same task, same budget, paired gate/no-gate paths, and immediate pre-delivery placement.'
limitations: 'absence from this set is not evidence that no prior work exists'; 'abstract/notes based only'; 'human full-text review is required before publication-grade novelty claims'
